items.title: More complete price history for Nordic stocks
items.headline: Price history coverage had slipped to 91% against a 95% goal; the fix improves how closing prices are handled for each exchange and for thinly traded stocks.
items.summary: T8 "Local bars coverage" read 108/119 (91%) on 2026-11-18 against a ≥95% target

items.title: Sigma-barrier study reorganised, results unchanged
items.headline: The study that re-checks past decisions against actual price history was restructured behind the scenes; its report and decision data stay identical to before.
added: The sigma-barrier re-resolution study SHALL keep its three responsibilities in separate modules inside the audit-and-validation package: the study (audit loading, point-in-time re-resolution, band and signal statistics, pre-registered predictions), the markdown rendering of the report, and the entry point that runs the study and writes the artifact pair.
The rendering SHALL be composed of named per-section steps, so that the function that assembles the report only orders them.

Invariant: for identical audit rows, bar history and run date, the restructured study SHALL write a byte-identical markdown report and per-decision JSONL sibling to the pre-refactor study, as proven by a golden equivalence test on fixed inputs that exists before the first structural change.
The study remains read-only towards data/decision_audit.jsonl and every other live data file; its only outputs stay under reports/analysis/.

items.title: Disclosure metabolism category retired
items.headline: The disclosure metabolism scoring category has been removed, so it no longer influences scores or recommendations or appears in what you see.
items.summary: Retire the category end to end

items.title: Report-day moves now weighed by trading volume
items.headline: After an interim report, the price move is now judged alongside how heavy trading was that day. It is shown for information only and does not affect recommendations.
items.summary: Add a SHADOW component report_drift_volume next to report_drift (src/investor/decision_components/universe/)
added: A report_drift_volume SHADOW scoring category SHALL score a name whose latest interim report session lies within the active drift window on its report-day return weighted by that session's volume ratio: report-day volume divided by the median volume of the 60 sessions before it, using only bars on or before the scoring step's decision instant.

A name SHALL score neutral (insufficient data) when fewer than 40 of those 60 prior sessions carry a positive volume, or when a share split (a change in the split-adjustment factor of the share-count history) falls within 65 sessions before or 5 sessions after the report session.
The category SHALL be SHADOW evidence (logged, never in the live composite) and SHALL gain live weight only through investor.replay.promotion.evaluate() against a challenger policy that opts it in.

items.title: Earnings outlook checks now use published figures
items.headline: When a profit prediction can't be checked from the usual data, it is now judged against the company's own originally published quarterly earnings, so results are scored more reliably.
items.summary: When the provider statements do not resolve a prediction, read both the target and the year-ago quarter's EPS from silver report_key_figures (as-published MFN interim figures, never restated): the target release is the earliest published within 100 days after the target quarter end, the year-ago release has the same pe

items.title: Smarter check that data updates ran
items.headline: The automatic health check no longer raises false alarms when the daily data refresh runs on a reduced schedule, while still catching a missed or stalled refresh.
items.summary: Keep the 5-hour age reading, and add a second reading that passes when the healer log was written at or after the healer timer's LastTriggerUSec and that trigger is less than 26 hours old
added: The watchdog's "healer ran" check is schedule-aware, superseding the fixed "healer ran within 5 hours" wording in the Watchdog deltas above. The healer counts as having run when its log was written within 5 hours, or when its log was written at or after the healer timer's most recent trigger and that trigger is less than 26 hours old. Only when both readings fail is the healer reported stale and the timers restarted.

A host-local timer override that thins the healer's calendar (such as a once-a-day maintenance window) therefore does not, by itself, fail the watchdog unit every tick; a healer that missed its own scheduled run, or a healer timer that has not fired for a day, still does.
The log detail distinguishes the two passing readings (ok:<N>h for the age reading, ok-schedule:<N>h for the trigger reading) from stale:<N>h.

items.title: Weekly memo ranks actions by money earned
items.headline: The weekly memo now ranks actions by expected profit after trading costs, and shows trades not worth their costs as cash placements or fallback sales.
items.summary: Change what the memo ranks first, not what the engine scores.
added: The weekly memo SHALL rank its actions by expected net SEK value over a stated horizon, not by composite score magnitude. A trade's expected value SHALL be its size times the measured gross excess return of its action group over the scored universe, taking the lower of the live and replay readings, minus its estimated round-trip cost. A fee switch's expected value SHALL be its SEK/yr saving over the same horizon minus its own switch cost. This ranking supersedes the fee-switch placement "after its ranked trades" in the fund-replacement-map delta; the switch keeps its selection rule and is ranked by its expected value like any other action.

A discretionary BUY whose expected net value is not positive SHALL be shown as a cash placement, not as a trade, SHALL be listed only when uninvested cash covers its size, and SHALL NOT displace an action with positive expected value from the memo's ranked actions.

A discretionary TRIM or EXIT whose expected net value is not positive SHALL be shown as the holding to sell first if cash is needed, not as a trade. An exit required by a risk rule or a BLOCK concern (the engine gated the verdict, or its worst concern is BLOCK) SHALL rank ahead of every other action, in composite order, with its presentation unchanged.
A fee switch whose expected value is not positive SHALL be shown as a switch whose saving does not yet cover its cost over the horizon, and SHALL rank with the other non-positive actions.

items.title: Seasonality signal removed
items.headline: The seasonal pattern signal is being removed from the app, so recommendations no longer rely on calendar-based patterns.

items.title: Promising ideas now become ready-to-run experiments
items.headline: When an idea can't yet become a recommendation, it's now turned into a ready experiment with its test and stop rule intact, and it no longer counts as open.
items.summary: Stage B (idea triage) routes signal stubs it cannot promote as proposals "to spike slot openspec/spikes/ with pre-registered rule"
added: An idea stub that triage routes to the spike slot SHALL carry the header status routed -> spike:<spike-id> (<YYYY-MM-DD>), distinct from rejected, and SHALL be counted as closed, not open, in the idea backlog.

For every routed stub whose spike file does not exist, the triage run SHALL write openspec/spikes/<spike-id>.md in state ready, carrying the stub's hypothesis, data source, testability and the kill rule recorded at triage unchanged.

A routed stub whose spike file cannot pass spike validation SHALL stay routed with a logged reason and no spike file; one whose test needs data that does not exist yet SHALL go to DATA_WATCH.md instead.
Writing spike files from routed stubs SHALL be idempotent.

items.title: Holdings now revalued every day
items.headline: Your holdings are repriced daily using the latest closing prices, exchange rates and fund values, so portfolio totals no longer go stale; holdings without a price source keep the broker's value.
items.summary: Nothing marks the owner's holdings to market, so T1 and every figure multiplied by it are weeks old.
added: Every tracked holding SHALL be repriced once per pulse: stocks and ETFs at the latest daily close times the current FX rate, funds at their latest published NAV where a feed exists.
The mark SHALL be stored as marked_value_sek, marked_at and mark_source in a sidecar keyed by holding id, beside the broker-imported current_value_sek, which the mark SHALL NOT overwrite.

A fund whose holding records value rather than units SHALL be marked by the ratio of its latest NAV to the NAV recorded when that broker value was first seen; a new broker value SHALL reset that reference.
A holding with no price source SHALL keep its broker value and be counted as unmarked; the T1 detail SHALL report how many holdings were marked and on which date.
